fusions.name: Hole-Corner Shot
fusions.desc: Looses an arrow at a target up to 9 tiles away that deals 30 damage, rising to 1.4 times that at full reach. Every hit is a critical hit.

fusions.name: Skitter Pair
fusions.desc: Looses 2 arrows at once, each dealing 3 damage.

fusions.name: Skirting the Wall
fusions.desc: Veils you for 8 seconds and increases your movement speed by 20% while it lasts. Enemies notice you far later, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Gone Before Noticed
fusions.desc: At night, your dodge chance rises 12%.
